decision_context: Mike wants a differentiated discovery system for items 1-5 that can be executed from a handful of prompts using 5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna aliases.
No publishing, submission, deployment, spend, outreach, or live product change is authorized.
acceptance: Dated baseline and evidence manifest exist.
All jobs have non-overlapping ownership and a dependency map.
Every external action is represented as a Mike approval gate.
approval_gate: Mike selects which prepared workstreams enter external execution.

decision_context: The current product exposes an owner-scoped read-only remote MCP server with manual bearer-token setup.
Prepare listing and product-gap packets, but do not publish to a registry or submit to a directory.
acceptance: Current official requirements are dated and linked for each platform.
Current-compatible work is separated from product/authentication changes.
A redacted verification and submission-readiness packet exists for each platform.
approval_gate: Mike approves any registry publication, directory submission, OAuth/product slice, or public claim.

decision_context: Lead with spoken thought to structured value; MCP is the differentiated proof.
Produce an approval-ready proof kernel and derivatives, not published media.
acceptance: One verified proof kernel has one audience, promise, proof, CTA, and experiment ID.
All claims and visual sources have evidence status.
Release blockers remain explicit until real exports, direct inspection, rights review, and Mike approval.
approval_gate: Mike approves creative direction, provider spend, final assets, and publishing.

decision_context: Establish current discovery and conversion baselines before setting lift targets.
Prepare ASO, custom product page, product page optimization, Apple Ads, SEO, and attribution work without submitting metadata or activating spend.
acceptance: Intent and metadata recommendations cite current evidence and do not invent volume.
Each experiment has one variable, control, metric, threshold caveat, and stop rule.
Campaign links and product pages map to named audiences and proof.
approval_gate: Mike approves App Store metadata/submissions, product-page experiments, Apple Ads budget/activation, and website publication.

decision_context: The owned surface must show the actual product proof in the first experience and lead to an attributed App Store action.
Prepare the approved build packet in marketing/discovery; do not deploy or overwrite the current website without Mike's design approval.
acceptance: Information architecture, copy, proof storyboard, SEO map, and build acceptance criteria agree.
Public copy uses verified claims and does not state an unsupported comparative superlative.
Mobile/desktop, accessibility, performance, indexing, and attribution checks are specified with evidence outputs.
approval_gate: Mike approves product/design direction and deployment before website files or hosting are changed.

decision_context: Use a small high-fit pilot, useful proof, individualized drafts, and honest disclosure.
Do not retain private contact data in git or send outreach.
acceptance: A maximum 12-person first review cohort has dated public fit evidence and conflict checks.
Outreach and community drafts are individualized, useful, and disclosure-ready.
Private contact details/messages are excluded and all sends remain gated.
approval_gate: Mike approves each outreach send, community post, compensation term, and content-rights arrangement.

decision_context: Integrate evidence without averaging away conflicts or upgrading hypotheses into facts.
Return no more than five bounded decisions for Mike and list external actions not taken.
acceptance: Every workstream is independently checked against its acceptance contract.
Cross-stream claims, links, metrics, ownership, and approval gates agree.
The final packet gives one operating action and no more than five explicit Mike decisions.
approval_gate: Mike approves, revises, or defers each proposed external action.
